STIPULATION FOR HEARING BEFORE PRO TEM COMMISSIONER FILED BY KARPANIAN, HAGOP NALBANDYAN, ALESYA AKOUBJIAN, MOUHIR DBA MTH PHOTOGRAPHERS

THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITH PREJUDICE. PLAINTIFF'S HAGOP KARPANIAN AND ALESYA NALBANDYAN ARE BOTH PRESENT. DEFENDANT MOUHIR AKOUBJIAN IS PRESENT. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. DEFENDANT WAIVES RIGHT TO SERVICE. SAN FRANCISCO IS NOT THE PROPER VENUE FOR THIS MATTER AS THE CONTRACT WAS NOT SIGNED, PERFORMED OR BREACHED IN SAN FRANCISCO. DEFENDANT REFUSES TO STIPULATE TO SAN FRANCISCO AS PROPER VENUE. MATTER DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE ON OPEN RECORD BY PRO TEM COMMISSIONER JEAN MILEFF. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: JEAN MILEFF; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. (506)
